This is an appeal under Section 374(2) of Cr.P.C. filed by the appellants against the judgment and order dated 09.05.2024 passed by learned Sessions Judge, Pithoragarh in Sessions Trial No.3 of 2021 "State Vs. Kushal Singh and another", whereby the appellants have been convicted under Sections 306 and 498A IPC and sentenced to undergo five years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of 50,000/- and three years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of 25,000/- respectively.
